rows.ARS:
Pink blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: JACnepal
Exhibition name: Gemini (hybrid tea, Zary 1999)
rows.Origin:
Bred by Dr. Keith W. Zary (United States, 1991).
Introduced in United States by Bear Creek Gardens, Inc. in 1999 as 'Gemini'.
rows.Bloom: Pink blend, pink edges. Mild fragrance. 25 to 30 petals. Average diameter 5". Double (17-25 petals), borne mostly solitary, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Upright, well-branched. Glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 4' to 6' (120 to 185cm). Width: 3' (90cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) . Can be grown in the ground or in a container (container requires winter protection).
